---
title: "Labs"
---

These labs are the hands-on part of the course. Each lab is designed to be runnable end-to-end and includes exercises.

::: {.callout-tip}
**Tip**  
If you get stuck, start from the top of the lab and run chunks in order.
:::

## A Dataset To Rule Them All

All the labs listed below are topic-specific and include solutions. Instead, you can practice everything from scratch using the [oh God I collected so many data and I don't know what to do now dataset](labs/sem_school_adjustment_project-description.html){target="_blank"}. You can download the data from `/data/processed` folder which also include a codebook.
